Dear Benjamin,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
After carefully checking the logs of the charger at the timestamp that was given, we see that the connection was lost between the car and the charger in that specific moment. This had to do with a network error.
At the moment we can`t see any errors in the charger, and the charger looks healthy:
Please provide us with feedback, if this problem occurred again, so we can close this ticket.
Thank you.
Best regards,
Priscilla van Wettum

additional_info.subject: ID0467174-DC/Si-D/DE-[multiple ]charging power CRM:02698000704
additional_info.body:
Dear Benjamin,
Thank you for your email.
Unfortunately we can not see the root cause behind this network error.
In most cases it is a communication error between the car and the charger.
In the case where the car does not communicate properly to the charger, a network error can occur.
I hope this answers your question.
In case you face any other issues with the charger, don`t hesitate to contact us.
If you provide us with feedback, i can close this ticket.
Thank you.
Best regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
